info.title: SecondBox API
info.description: Provider-neutral administration and durable Sandbox API.

get.description: Lists Subjects in the tenant fixed by the authenticated controller. No tenant assertion is accepted.

post.description: Creates a Subject in the tenant fixed by the authenticated controller. No tenant assertion is accepted.

get.description: Gets a Subject in the tenant fixed by the authenticated controller. An absent or out-of-tenant Subject returns the same non-enumerating not_found Problem.

put.description: Replaces a Subject quota in the tenant fixed by the authenticated controller. The quota must remain within the Tenant ceiling and cannot be narrowed below committed usage.

post.description: Creates or returns the one durable cleanup Operation for a closed Subject; retries with the same idempotency key converge on the same Operation.

get.description: Lists non-secret authorities in the tenant fixed by the authenticated controller.

post.description: Creates an authority in the tenant fixed by authentication. The bearer token appears only in this successful response.

get.description: Gets a non-secret authority in the authenticated tenant. An absent or out-of-tenant authority returns the same non-enumerating not_found Problem.

post.description: Rotates an authority in the authenticated tenant and returns the replacement bearer token exactly once.

get.description: Returns aggregate and per-Subject usage for the tenant fixed by the authenticated controller.
Returns deployment-wide aggregate usage and one stable page of per-Tenant aggregate usage for the platform operator.

201.description: Profile created with its first immutable revision.

200.description: Profile with new immutable current revision.
Administrative Runner projection without credential material.
Bounded current-deployment timing percentiles without resource identifiers.

202.description: Sandbox creation accepted and observable as an Operation.
Sandbox deletion accepted as a durable lifecycle operation.

200.description: Sandbox with replaced application correlation metadata.
Bounded Project-scoped Sandbox lifecycle, boot-stage, and Exec timing history.
Fresh bounded health and activity observation without activity renewal.

post.description: Observes guest health and never renews idle activity.
Explicitly renews useful activity for the current generation.
Asynchronously replaces a stopped Sandbox workspace with a writable copy of one of that Sandbox's ready Snapshots.
Bounded observation that never renews activity.

200.description: Project-scoped Operation queue, execution, and boot-stage timing.

202.description: Streaming Exec cancellation accepted; the session remains observable until its terminal acknowledgement.

get.description: Returns an authenticated WebSocket connection descriptor for a detached PTY.

202.description: Terminal cancellation accepted; the session remains observable until its terminal acknowledgement.

platformBearer.description: Deployment-wide operator authority. This credential never enters application workloads.

tenantControllerBearer.description: Code-owned management authority fixed to exactly one tenant. Controller routes derive the tenant from this credential and reject tenant assertion headers.

applicationBearer.description: Application authority fixed to one tenant, one subject, exact Sandbox scopes, and explicit Profile grants.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: True when the original result is replayed.

ContentLength.description: Exact response body size in bytes.

RetryAfter.description: Minimum whole seconds before retrying a temporary admission refusal.

TimingLimit.name: limit
TimingLimit.description: Maximum number of recent Operations and recent Execs returned independently.

TimingWindowSeconds.name: windowSeconds
TimingWindowSeconds.description: Current-deployment aggregation window. API timing uses fixed one-minute buckets.

PageCursor.name: cursor
PageCursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned as nextCursor by the same endpoint and exact filter scope.

SandboxMetadataFilter.name: metadata
SandboxMetadataFilter.description: Repeatable name=value Metadata containment filter; a Sandbox matches only when it carries every supplied pair. Only the first '=' separates, so a value may contain one. The reserved name key is secondbox.dev/name, unique per tenant and subject among Sandboxes that are not deleted. A nextCursor is bound to the exact filter that produced it and is rejected against any other filter.

TenantControllerCredentialCreated.description: Tenant-controller authority and its one-time bearer token. The idempotency key prevents a duplicate record but cannot replay bearer material: a retry after the initial response returns credential_response_unavailable. If this response is uncertain, inspect by idempotency or correlation identity, revoke the record, and create a replacement; the token cannot be recovered.

TenantControllerCredentialRotated.description: Rotated tenant-controller authority and its one-time replacement bearer token. The idempotency key prevents a second rotation but cannot replay bearer material; after an uncertain response, inspect and revoke this authority, then create a replacement.

ApplicationCredentialCreated.description: Application authority and its one-time bearer token. The idempotency key prevents a duplicate record but cannot replay bearer material: a retry after the initial response returns credential_response_unavailable. If this response is uncertain, inspect by idempotency or correlation identity, revoke the record, and create a replacement; the token cannot be recovered.

ApplicationCredentialRotated.description: Rotated application authority and its one-time replacement bearer token. The idempotency key prevents a second rotation but cannot replay bearer material; after an uncertain response, inspect and revoke this authority, then create a replacement.

DeploymentUsageOK.description: Deployment-wide aggregate and per-Tenant usage page.

ManagementUnavailable.description: The authenticated management operation is not admitted because its durable management store is unavailable.

AcceptedOperation.description: Mutation accepted and observable as an Operation.

Problem404.description: Resource not found in the authenticated scope.

Problem409.description: Current state, generation, Lease, quota, or idempotency conflict.

Problem412.description: Resource revision does not match If-Match.

Problem413.description: Configured byte or item limit exceeded.

AuthorityKind.description: The fixed authority hierarchy. Kinds cannot be selected or widened by a credential request.

TokenLookupID.description: Public non-secret token lookup identifier. It is safe to return from read and list operations and cannot authenticate by itself.

TenantControllerBearerToken.description: Complete high-entropy tenant-controller bearer credential returned only by a successful creation or rotation response. It cannot be recovered later.

ApplicationBearerToken.description: Complete high-entropy application bearer credential returned only by a successful creation or rotation response. It cannot be recovered later.

CreateTenantControllerAuthorityRequest.description: The platform selects only metadata and expiry; the authority kind, tenant binding, and code-owned management grant cannot be caller-selected.

CreateApplicationAuthorityRequest.description: Creates only an application authority in the authenticated tenant. Kind and tenant cannot be supplied, and scopes and Profile grants must be subsets of the tenant ceiling.

AuditCorrelationMetadata.description: Bounded external correlation metadata. Bearer tokens, verifiers, and other credential material are forbidden.

AuditAttribution.description: Attribution recorded for every management mutation and denial. Credential bearer and verifier material is never recorded.

StartupMode.description: cold_boot starts a Sandbox by booting its guest. snapshot_resume resumes a prepared, identity-neutral guest, admits only onto Runners advertising the snapshot-resume capability, and never falls back to cold_boot.

StartupPolicy.description: How every Instance of this Profile revision reaches ready. There is no default; an operator states the mode on every Profile revision and the immutable revision pins it.

dataBase64.description: Ordered process standard-input bytes; empty only when endOfInput is true.

endOfInput.description: Closes process standard input after dataBase64; subsequent stdin frames are invalid.
